definitions.explanation: Discussion aimed at reaching an agreement.

examples.japanese: {交渉|こうしょう}が{決裂|けつれつ}した。
{給料|きゅうりょう}の{交渉|こうしょう}をしたが、なかなかまとまらなかった。
examples.english: I negotiated my salary, but it was hard to reach an agreement.

notes:
{交渉|こうしょう} refers to discussion aimed at reaching an agreement between two or more parties. Used in both formal (diplomatic, business) and everyday (salary, contract) contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {交渉|こうしょう}する: to negotiate
- {交渉|こうしょう}に{応|おう}じる: to respond to/accept negotiations
- {交渉|こうしょう}がまとまる: negotiations conclude successfully
- {交渉|こうしょう}が{決裂|けつれつ}する: negotiations break down
- {交渉|こうしょう}の{余地|よち}: room for negotiation

COMMON TYPES:
- {賃金|ちんぎん}{交渉|こうしょう}: wage negotiation
- {外交|がいこう}{交渉|こうしょう}: diplomatic negotiation
- {団体|だんたい}{交渉|こうしょう}: collective bargaining

WORD FORMATION:
{交|こう} (exchange) + {渉|しょう} (cross over, deal with).
